intro.text: One of the Uvara, a legendary people in the story of the Wandersail.

items.text: In a story Wit told Kaladin, King Derethil's ship, the Wandersail, was wrecked in a highstorm on the uncharted islands of the Uvara. They seemed peaceful, but they killed each other for any mistake, fearing to displease their emperor.

Derethil's crew found the emperor had been dead for years, and the Uvara fell into chaos. Nafti, who had been the crew's guide, left with them on the Wandersail. She explained that her people were in anguish because they knew they alone were responsible for all the killing.

appearance.text: Like other Uvara, she has a long, limber body, wears shells in her hair that are found nowhere else on Roshar, and dresses in single-coloured robes.
